item.title: Scott Tinsley, dead at 62, remembered for being ahead of his time as offensive mind
item.description: Tinsley was head football coach at WVU Tech and West Virginia State, had a lengthy stint on Nitro High School's staff between his role as an assistant and head coach and worked at Hurricane, St. Albans, George Washington and Buffalo more recently. The post Scott Tinsley, dead at 62, remembered for being ahead of his time as offensive mind appeared first on WV MetroNews.
